title: 第23章 学习使我快乐第24章 喝下这碗毒鸡汤我们就是朋友了
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
书阁。
某个逼旮角落。
郑拓拿了几本阵法基础理论教学认真阅读。
阵法，一种依附天道而生的辅助类修行工具。
阵法的种类有很多。
最常见的包括攻击类阵法，保护类阵法，辅助类阵法……等等。
对于阵法的基础理念，郑拓是知晓的。
毕竟他为加入落仙宗准备了十年。
如今只是谨慎起见，在复习一遍。
看看落仙宗内的阵法基础与自己所学有没有什么不同之处。
学习是一个需要专注的过程。
为此。
郑拓特意在自己的周围设置有三十张警报灵符。
每当有人靠近他十米范围后，警报灵符便会爆发出刺耳的警报声，从而提醒他有人靠近。
布置好后，郑拓拿起书本，开始认真学习。
也许是因为成为修仙者的缘故。
郑拓发现自己现在的记忆力非同凡响。
在亲测后，他惊讶的发现。
自己竟可以做到一目十行，过目不忘的本领。
也许这就是修仙者的异人之处吧。

郑拓虽然很开心，但并未骄傲。
他是一个做事很专注的人。
拿起书本，一丝不苟的认认真真学习。
同时。
他有一个非常良好的习惯，就是记笔记。
没有办法。
以他现在的神魂强度，还不足以雕刻玉简。
所以，只能用自制铅笔来记笔记。
认真学习的日子总是过的飞快。
三天后。
郑拓将落仙宗记载的所有阵法基础理论全部学会。
“啊……”
放下手中书籍，伸个懒腰。
亏得现在为修仙者。
肉身无时无刻不被灵气滋养。
不然就这样不吃不喝坐上三天，怕是早就猝死后在度穿越。
心中默念落仙决，试图催动法门缓解一身的疲惫。
content_en:
Bookstore.
Some corner.
Zheng Tuo took several textbooks on the basic theory of formation and read them carefully.
Formation, a kind of auxiliary cultivation tool that relies on the way of heaven.
There are many types of formations.
The most common ones include attack formations, protection formations, auxiliary formations... and so on.
Zheng Tuo knew the basic concepts of the formation.
After all, he had prepared for ten years to join the Luo Xian Sect.
Now I'm just reviewing it out of caution.
See if there is any difference between the basic formations in Luo Xian Sect and what you have learned.
Learning is a process that requires concentration.
to this end.
Zheng Tuo deliberately set up thirty alarm talismans around himself.
Whenever someone comes within ten meters of him, the alarm talisman will emit a piercing alarm sound to alert him that someone is approaching.
After setting it up, Zheng Tuo picked up the book and began to study seriously.
Maybe it's because of becoming a cultivator.
Zheng Tuo found that his current memory was extraordinary.
After testing it himself, he was surprised to find out.
He can actually see ten lines in one glance and have a photographic memory.
Maybe this is what makes immortal cultivators different.
Although Zheng Tuo was happy, he was not proud.
He is a very dedicated person.
Pick up the book and study carefully and conscientiously.
at the same time.
He has a very good habit of taking notes.
There is no way.
His current soul strength is not enough to carve jade slips.
Therefore, I can only use homemade pencils to take notes.
The days of serious study always fly by.
Three days later.
Zheng Tuo learned all the basic theories of formations recorded in the Luoxian Sect.
"Ah..."
Put down your books and stretch your legs.
Fortunately, I am now a cultivator.
The physical body is nourished by spiritual energy all the time.
Otherwise, if he sat like this for three days without eating or drinking, he would probably die suddenly before traveling through time.
He silently recited the Fallen Immortal Jue in his mind, trying to activate the technique to relieve his fatigue.
